summary: Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that Craig Abruzzo assumed the role of Co-Chief Operating Officer of Morgan Stanley Investment Management Inc., the Trust's delegated sponsor, and was appointed a director of that sponsor, effective October 1, 2026. The filing is a routine governance disclosure about a new officer at the sponsor, not a departure. Abruzzo remains a Managing Director and previously led Enterprise Controls and co-headed Foreign Exchange and Emerging Markets. No deal terms, board recommendation or advisors are stated. No structural or arb-relevant event; no action required.
